AgentTrace.description: `GET /runs/{run_id}/agent-trace`: the trace lines (03 §9.2) and the server-side chain check.
AgentTrace.title: AgentTrace

AgentTraceLine.description:
One line of Relentra's hash-chained agent_trace.jsonl (AI on only): a
state-machine transition, an LLM call or a tool call. Lines are flushed one by
one in seq order; the receipt's agent_trace_head is the last line_hash (03 §9.2,
08 §5.3).
AgentTraceLine.title: AgentTraceLine

Alert.description:
Alert time and analysis windows of one run (03 §2.6): the protocol, t_alert after
the onset shift, the half-open baseline and incident windows clamped to the data
span, and the detector that fired under the detected protocol. Written by core's
alert step (pipeline step 1); engines from Signalyth on read it instead of any
injection time.
Alert.title: Alert

AlertDetector.description: Breach found by the alert detector on the entry service(s).
AlertDetector.title: AlertDetector

AlertWindows.description:
Analysis windows around t_alert_ns from config core.windows, each half-open
[start_ns, end_ns) and clamped to [data_start_ns, data_end_ns + 1); contiguous
windows are allowed.
AlertWindows.title: AlertWindows

BudgetUsed.description:
Budget consumed. turns counts LLM calls including repairs; tokens are
provider-reported usage stored in the cassette; wall_ms is the sum of recorded
call latencies, so a replay reproduces it.
BudgetUsed.title: BudgetUsed

Card.description:
Human-readable incident card for one sealed verdict: title, copied
status/root/confidence/candidate set, checked summary prose, timeline,
propagation path, evidence table, why-not, asks and deterministic next steps.
Produced by Causivra (step 10a, with card.md rendered from it); it never changes
the verdict.
Card.title: Card

CardNarrator.description: How the summary prose was produced (10 §2.2).
CardNarrator.title: CardNarrator

CaseManifest.description:
Descriptive manifest of one materialised case: opaque id, dataset, data span,
present sources, services, raw inputs, adapter and scrub counts (03 §2.1).
Written by Infralume at pipeline step 0.
CaseManifest.title: CaseManifest

CaseManifestInput.description: One raw input file of the case.
CaseManifestInput.title: CaseManifestInput

CasePage.description: `GET /cases`: one page of case summaries, sorted by case id.
CasePage.title: CasePage

CaseSummary.description:
`case_summary` (06 §3.2). `system` and `sources` come from the newest finished run's case
manifest and are null before the case's first run; never answer keys or hints.
CaseSummary.title: CaseSummary

ChangesRow.description:
One row of changes.parquet: a change-kind event from telemetry.events on the
reference clock, with its scope, proximity to the target onset and
changed-vs-peer contrast (03 §5.2). Written by Causync.
ChangesRow.title: ChangesRow

Claim.description:
A library predicate the proposer wants checked. The subject is implied
(hypothesis.service for T10; every claim-pass pool candidate in FaultLoom's claim
pass).
Claim.title: Claim

Confidence.description:
Verdict confidence (03 §10, 09 §3.9); computed normally under NO_FAULT with
set_size 0. Shared with card.confidence.
Confidence.title: Confidence

DatasetSummary.description: `GET /datasets` (06 §3.2): a dataset this laptop knows and its case count.
DatasetSummary.title: DatasetSummary

EvidencePage.description: `GET /runs/{run_id}/evidence`: one page of evidence rows (03 §7) after the filters.
EvidencePage.title: EvidencePage

EvidenceRow.description:
One row of evidence: an evidence atom for one candidate service, one kind and one
set of defining arguments, with its value, window and source references. Produced
by FaultLoom: engine atoms in the engine pass, claim_check and intervention atoms
appended in the claim pass (03 §7, 06 §2.2, §3).
EvidenceRow.title: EvidenceRow

GraphEdgesRow.description:
One row of graph.edges: a caller -> callee edge of the dependency graph, merged
by (src, dst) from traces, topology hints and log mentions, with its call share
and incident anomaly flag. Produced by Causalith (03 §6.2, 05 §3.4); self-loops
are dropped.
GraphEdgesRow.title: GraphEdgesRow

GraphNodesRow.description:
One row of graph.nodes: a node of the service dependency graph with its kind,
entry flag and evidence sources. Produced by Causalith (03 §6.1, 05 §3.1-§3.3).
GraphNodesRow.title: GraphNodesRow

GraphPathsRow.description:
One row of graph.paths: one of the k best simple propagation paths from a
candidate node to an entry service, against the call direction. Produced by
Causalith for every node that can reach an entry (03 §6.3, 05 §3.6).
GraphPathsRow.title: GraphPathsRow

GraphView.description: `GET /runs/{run_id}/graph`: the three graph tables (03 §6) as contract rows.
GraphView.title: GraphView

HealthAI.description: AI defaults the console shows. `reachable` is null until the provider probe exists (X-04).
HealthAI.title: HealthAI

Hypothesis.description:
Proposed root cause. service must be a graph.nodes.node (checked by Causentra as
unknown_entity, not by this schema).
Hypothesis.title: Hypothesis

LiveRequest.description:
`POST /live/diagnose` and `/live/snapshot` body (06 §3.4): minutes of data before the
trigger, default `live.snapshot_before_min`.
LiveRequest.title: LiveRequest

LiveSnapshot.description: `POST /live/snapshot` (06 §3.4): the content-derived id of the snapshot written.
LiveSnapshot.title: LiveSnapshot

LiveStatus.title: LiveStatus

Onsets.description:
Per-service external and internal onsets and the incident onset t_onset, written
by Anomara as onsets.json (03 §4.2). Onsets are in source time; consumers add the
alignment offset of the recorded *_onset_source (and service).
Onsets.title: Onsets

OnsetsPerService.description:
Onsets of one service; *_source and its onset are null together (enforced by the
allOf below).
OnsetsPerService.title: OnsetsPerService

Proposal.description:
One hypothesis with the predicate claims and trials that would test it.
proposal_id = P + first 8 hex of SHA-256(canonical_json({hypothesis, claims
without claim_id})).
Proposal.title: Proposal

ProposalAsk.description: A request for more telemetry, a trial or context.
ProposalAsk.title: ProposalAsk

Proposals.description:
Hypotheses, predicate claims and trial requests proposed by Relentra (pipeline
step 7, AI on only), or submitted externally through the MCP verify_hypothesis
tool (mode external). Proposals never decide: FaultLoom's claim pass re-evaluates
every claim for every claim-pass pool candidate, and Causentra reads the result
(03 §9.1).
Proposals.title: Proposals

ProposalsModel.description:
LLM provider, model identity and sampler parameters of the run (config/llm.yaml,
config/relentra.yaml).
ProposalsModel.title: ProposalsModel

Receipt.description:
Verdict receipt (03 §11.2): an in-toto Statement v1 whose subject is verdict.json
and whose predicate carries the run manifest, verdict_hash, card_hash and the
agent-trace head, so `veyltrace replay` can re-check the verdict. Written by
Causivra at step 10b as canonical JSON; it keeps the in-toto shape, so it has no
schema_version and predicateType carries the version.
Receipt.title: Receipt

ReceiptDigest.description: Digest set of the subject file.
ReceiptDigest.title: ReceiptDigest

ReceiptPredicate.description: What replay re-checks: the embedded run manifest and the three result hashes.
ReceiptPredicate.title: ReceiptPredicate

ReceiptSubject.description: The verdict file this receipt attests.
ReceiptSubject.title: ReceiptSubject

ReplayReport.description:
`replay_report` (06 §3.2; 10 §3.9): the replay's state and exit code with its meaning
(`veyltrace_core.errors.ReplayExit`, e.g. 0 ok, 2 hash_mismatch, 6 narrative_mismatch).
ReplayReport.title: ReplayReport

Root.description:
Classification of the leader: copied from the slate entry for slate candidates,
from Causatrix classify() for proposal-origin candidates (09 §3.9). Shared with
card.root.
Root.title: Root

RunManifest.description:
Provenance manifest of one finished run (03 §12): ids, code commit, environment,
config/uv.lock/calibration hashes, input and output file hashes, AI provenance
and per-step output hashes, with no timestamps or timings (P3). Written by core
at the manifest step, after Causivra's card (10a) and before the receipt (10b),
which embeds it.
RunManifest.title: RunManifest

RunManifestAI.description:
AI provenance, merged by core from the ai_manifest of every engine that called an
LLM (Relentra, Causivra). With mode off every other field is null (enforced by
the if/then below).
RunManifestAI.title: RunManifestAI

RunManifestEnv.description:
Runtime environment. Replay exit 5 compares Python major.minor and libs (with
uv_lock_sha256); os is reported, never compared, so a Windows-recorded receipt
replays on Linux CI.
RunManifestEnv.title: RunManifestEnv

RunManifestFile.description: One file and the SHA-256 of its bytes.
RunManifestFile.title: RunManifestFile

RunManifestInput.description:
One raw case input copied from case_manifest.inputs: its name and the SHA-256 of
its bytes.
RunManifestInput.title: RunManifestInput

RunManifestStep.description: One pipeline sub-step and the files it wrote.
RunManifestStep.title: RunManifestStep

RunStatus.description: `run_status` (06 §3.2). `step` is core's step index (0-13), `step_name` its name.
RunStatus.title: RunStatus

SamplerParams.description: Sampler parameters actually sent to the provider.
SamplerParams.title: SamplerParams

SignalCubeSeriesRow.description:
One point of a typed signal series (metric, trace or log derived), tagged with
family and klass (03 §3.1). Written by Signalyth over the whole data range,
independent of alert windows.
SignalCubeSeriesRow.title: SignalCubeSeriesRow

Slate.description:
Hypothesis slate written by Causatrix (pipeline step 6): the top-K root-cause
candidates from gated rank fusion of the active rankers, plus a fused score for
every service in the universe U. Read by Relentra and Causentra (03 §8).
Slate.title: Slate

SlateCandidate.description: One top-K candidate with its classification (07 §3.5-§3.6) and per-ranker votes.
SlateCandidate.title: SlateCandidate

SlateFusion.description:
Fusion rule and its parameters. method rrf is the default; combsum_minmax and
borda are ablations (07 §9).
SlateFusion.title: SlateFusion

SlateScore.description: Fused score of one service in U.
SlateScore.title: SlateScore

Sources.description:
Per-source presence switches; shared by case_manifest.sources and Causatrix's
Sources type (contract_changes B).
Sources.title: Sources

Verdict.description:
The sealed RCA decision for one run: status, root, conformal candidate set, every
decision-pool candidate with its trial results, confidence, asks and proposal
outcomes. Produced by Causentra (pipeline step 9); the only artifact that sets
the verdict.
Verdict.title: Verdict

VerdictCalibration.description:
The calibration used: its family id and the SHA-256 of the calibration file bytes
(the same value as run_manifest.calibration_sha256), or family "uncalibrated"
with sha256 = sha256_json({"family": "uncalibrated"}) (09 §3.7, contract_changes
B).
VerdictCalibration.title: VerdictCalibration

schema.title: Response List Datasets Api V1 Datasets Get
Response List Runs Api V1 Runs Get
Response Get Changes Api V1 Runs  Run Id  Changes Get
Response Get Series Api V1 Runs  Run Id  Series Get
